title: 第6章  极品水木双灵根！我女儿有成帝之姿
slug: 长生让你延续香火没让你量产仙帝
content_zh:
李长生将江翠萍安置在床上后，慌忙走出房门，去几里外的凡人村落找稳婆接生。
腿上贴上【神行符】。
迅速向凡人村落掠去。
半个时辰后。
李长生拽着气喘吁吁，满脸褶子的老妇人，冲进了院子。
“哎哟。”
“仙师，慢点，我这老骨头都快要散架了。”
王稳婆累得上气不接下气。
王稳婆也帮过几次修仙者接生，所以对修仙者没有想象中那么畏惧。
李长生没有废话，直接从怀里摸出一块金币，塞进王稳婆手里。
“快帮忙接生。”
王稳婆走进了房间内，然后将门关上。
“好的，仙师。”
李长生站在院子里，来回踱步，急得团团转。
尤其是听着屋内传来撕心裂肺的尖叫声时。
那颗在修仙界磨砺了六十年的坚硬道心，罕见地松动了。
女人为男人怀胎十月。
一朝分娩。
真的很不容易啊！
虽然李长生是穿越者，但不是铁石心肠。

江翠萍对他的好，都记在心里。
“哇。”
不知道过了多久，一声极其嘹亮，且带着穿透力的啼哭传来。
这哭声不似男婴那般粗犷，却细腻绵长，透着一股子顽强的生命力。
紧接着。
王稳婆充满喜气的声音就传了出来：
“生了。”
“恭喜李仙师，弄瓦之喜，是个水灵灵的千金。”
“长得可漂亮了，跟个瓷娃娃似的。”
“我帮人接生了几十年，还是第一次见到如此漂亮的女婴。”
李长生闻言，微微一怔。
随即嘴角不由自主地上扬。
女儿好啊！
女儿是爹的小棉袄。
比起臭小子。
其实他更想要个贴心的女儿。
在这个残酷的修仙界，若能护着一个粉雕玉琢的小丫头长大，看着她无忧无虑，未尝不是一种修行。
生女儿就当是红尘炼心了。
与此同时。
脑海中那久违的冰冷电子音响起。

【叮！】
【恭喜宿主，江翠萍诞下女婴。】
【家族血脉+1。】
【检测到首位子嗣诞生，开始结算奖励……】
【由于是宿主首位子嗣（长女），且母体为凡人，触发掌上明珠级暴击！】
【奖励一：宿主寿元+30年。】
【奖励二：宿主修为+10年。】
【奖励三：玄阶灵器：玄霜剑。】
【奖励四：气运加持（低级）：家族成员出门捡钱、逢凶化吉的概率微弱提升。】
【奖励五：长女获得极品双灵根（水、木双灵根）。】
【奖励六：长女获得太阴玄体（未觉醒）。】
即便李长生生活阅历丰富，但被这一连串的奖励砸下来，也高兴得一塌糊涂。
【寿元】
【修为】
【武器】
【气运】
四样都是好东西啊。
而且自己长女的天赋还是极品中的极品。
水木双灵根是修仙界公认的长生灵根。
水生木。

生生不息。
拥有这种灵根的修士。
虽然攻伐之力不如金火灵根狂暴，但恢复力极强，且擅长炼丹、种植灵药，是各大宗门争抢的【奶妈】和【后勤大总管】。
而还有一个【太阴玄体】……
李长生虽然没听说过具体功效，但凡是带【体质】二字的，在修仙界那都是万中无一的天才标配。
所以我生出了一个有真凤之姿的宝贝女儿？
李长生高兴地伸手，撸了撸胡子，压下心头的狂喜，走到王稳婆面前，将几枚金币递了过去。
“多谢王稳婆了。”
“多谢仙师。”
王稳婆也是个人精，拿了钱。
自然懂得什么该说，什么不该说。
李长生送走稳婆后，快步走进屋内。
屋内弥漫着淡淡的血腥气和奶香味。
江翠萍脸色苍白，头发被汗水浸湿，贴在额头上，显得格外虚弱。
但眼睛里却闪烁着母性的光辉。
爱怜地看着怀里粉粉嫩嫩的小包裹。
看到李长生进来，江翠萍挣扎着想要起身，眼眶微红，有些愧疚：
“夫君，对不起。是个丫头……”
在这个重男轻女的世道。
尤其是在讲究传承的家族观念里，头胎是女儿，往往会让妇人觉得抬不起头。

“说什么胡话呢？”
“姑娘怎么了？”
“姑娘也是心头肉。”
“在我这里，可没有这些重男轻女的思想。”
李长生佯装生气地瞪了江翠萍一眼。
随后走到江翠萍床边，顺势握住其手腕，将一股温和灵力渡入其体内。
江翠萍感觉到一股暖流游走全身。
生产带来的剧痛，竟然缓解了大半。
“夫君。”
“你真好。”
江翠萍松了一口气，情不自禁地开口。
说完之后。
便害羞得转过头。
不敢看李长生的眼睛。
刚出生的小家伙闭着眼，睫毛长长的。
虽然皮肤有些皱，但白里透红，小嘴嘟着，煞是可爱。
“夫君，给孩子取个名吧。”
江翠萍沉默了一会开口。
李长生沉吟片刻，点点头：
“那就叫做李以宁吧。”

“我不求她倾国倾城，也不求她权倾天下。”
“只想许她一生安宁。”
江翠萍喃喃重复：“李以宁……以宁……许你一生安宁……这寓意好啊。”
当天晚上。
当妻女睡觉了之后，李长生在床边布置了【聚灵阵】和【隔音阵】，让他们能睡眠更好一些。
随后一个人来到地下室，盘膝而坐，兴奋地开口：
“系统，具现奖励！”
【收到指令。】
【寿元+30年】
【修为提升。】
【获得玄阶灵器玄霜剑。】
【获得气运加持……】
随着系统的提示音落下，李长生体内升起一股暖流，练气六层巅峰的瓶颈，像是一层薄纸，瞬间被捅破，修为节节攀升。
练气七层。
练气八层。
练气九层。
修为一路暴涨，直到练气九层初期才停下。
李长生睁开眼，双眸隐隐有光芒流转。
这可是练气九层啊！
在青云宗外门，练气后期足以担任一名执事，管辖上百名弟子。

在这个安置区。
更是绝对的霸主级存在。
那个死鬼王麻子若是活着，见到现在的李长生，怕是得跪下来叫爷爷。
真给力。
接下来看看系统奖励的灵剑怎么样？
李长生心念一动，手中凭空出现一柄灵剑。
灵剑通体蓝色。
三尺剑锋。
冰霜覆盖。
符文流转。
寒光闪烁。
这便是玄阶的灵器。
据说只有亲传弟子才有机会获得玄阶灵器。
如今他一个被优化的弟子。
竟然拥有了玄阶灵器。
真是令人羡慕死。
无论怎么说，多了一项保命手段，都是值得高兴的事情。
随后李长生拉开属性面板，三维属性清晰可见。
【家族兴旺系统】
【宿主：李长生】

【道侣：江翠萍（无灵根凡人）】
【家族：李家（默默无闻）】
【剩余寿命：62】
【修为：练气九层】
【技能：灵符真解、基础剑法、基础拳法。】
【武器：玄霜剑】
【子嗣：长女：李以宁】
看着三维属性，李长生没有飘。
虽然长女的降生，让其实力变强了很多，但是责任也变大了。
家庭开销也变大了。
这些都是实实在在的压力。
宁宁水木双灵根，且身怀太阴玄体，若是长时间以凡人五谷喂养，会污了先天的灵气，必须得喝灵米熬的米汤，甚至是温和的灵兽奶。
这当父亲的压力不就来了？
而且为了掩盖孩子身上的灵根波动和体质异象。
还得去买一块【敛息佩】。
这又是一笔巨款。
亚历山大啊！
转念一想。
虽然培养闺女，耗费巨大。
但是自己的实力可是跟家族绑定的。

培养女儿。
发展家族。
并不亏。
李长生将玄霜剑收好，嘴角喃喃一声：
“看来只能去一趟鬼市了。”
第二天清晨，李长生安顿好妻女，布置好警示措施，以及陷阱。
这才微微心安出门、
虽然这里是青云山脚下的安置区，但并不是绝对安全的。
在修仙界，想要活得久，就得稳健。
李长生施展【缩骨功】，骨骼噼啪作响。
转眼，从佝偻老头，变成了腰杆笔直的黑脸汉子。
修为也压制在了练气六层。
刚好是那种【不好惹，但也别惹我】的散修标准。
随后……
穿上用灵力遮住脸。
便迅速往三十里开外的鬼市方向走去。
附近的坊市体量太低了，吃不下大批量的灵符，所以只能去鬼市冒险了。
鬼市位于一座废弃的矿洞之中。
是谁成立的已经不可考究。
但背后肯定有修仙门派的踪影，要不然不可能存在这么久，而不被剿灭。

李长生刚走到鬼市入口，两位练气期九层的修士，伸出手，挡住其去路。
“站住。”
“先交入场费。”
“每个人两块下品灵石。”
进入黑市还要交钱么？
真黑啊！
李长生在心里吐槽一声。
不过，他没有废话。
直接递过去两块灵石。
虽然进入黑市要花钱，但是能省下麻烦，未尝不是一件好事。
李长生领了黑色的斗篷，披在身上，就迅速混入了黑市人流中。
content_en:
After Li Changsheng placed Jiang Cuiping on the bed, he hurriedly walked out of the room and went to a mortal village a few miles away to find Po Wen to deliver the baby.
Put a [Magic Talisman] on your leg.
Quickly swept towards the mortal village.
Half an hour later.
Li Changsheng dragged the panting and wrinkled old woman into the yard.
"Ouch."
"Master Immortal, slow down, my old bones are about to fall apart."
Wang Wenpo was so tired that she was out of breath.
Wang Wenpo has also helped immortal cultivators deliver babies several times, so she is not as afraid of immortal cultivators as she imagined.
Li Changsheng didn't talk nonsense, he took out a gold coin from his arms and put it into Wang Wenpo's hand.
"Hurry and help deliver the baby."
Wang Wenpo walked into the room and closed the door.
"Okay, Immortal Master."
Li Changsheng stood in the courtyard, pacing back and forth, anxious.
Especially when hearing the heart-rending screams coming from inside the house.
The hard Taoist heart that had been honed in the world of immortality for sixty years was rarely loosened.
A woman carries a man for ten months.
Once in labor.
It’s really not easy!
Although Li Changsheng is a time traveler, he is not hard-hearted.
Jiang Cuiping kept all the good things she did to him in her heart.
"Wow."
I don’t know how long it took, but an extremely loud and penetrating cry came.
This cry was not as rough as that of a baby boy, but it was delicate and long, revealing a tenacious vitality.
Immediately afterwards.
Wang Wenpo's joyful voice came out:
"Giving birth."
"Congratulations to Master Li Xian, Nong Wa is so happy that he is a beautiful daughter."
"She's so beautiful, like a porcelain doll."
"I have been delivering babies for decades, and this is the first time I have seen such a beautiful baby girl."
Li Changsheng was slightly startled when he heard this.
Then the corners of his mouth rose involuntarily.
Hello, daughter!
My daughter is my father’s little cotton-padded jacket.
Compared to the brat.
In fact, he wants a caring daughter.
In this cruel world of cultivating immortals, if you can protect a beautiful little girl and watch her grow up carefree, it might as well be a kind of spiritual practice.
Giving birth to a daughter should be regarded as a journey in the world of mortals.
at the same time.
The long-lost cold electronic sound sounded in my mind.
【bite! 】
[Congratulations to the host, Jiang Cuiping gave birth to a baby girl. 】
[Family bloodline +1. 】
[The birth of the first heir has been detected, and rewards have begun to be settled...]
[Because she is the first child (eldest daughter) of the host, and her mother is a mortal, it triggers a palm-jewel-level critical strike! 】
[Reward 1: Host life span +30 years. 】
[Reward 2: Host’s cultivation +10 years. 】
[Reward three: Xuan level spiritual weapon: Xuan Shuang Sword. 】
[Reward 4: Luck Blessing (low level): The probability of family members going out to pick up money and turning bad luck into good fortune is slightly increased. 】
[Reward 5: The eldest daughter obtains the best double spiritual roots (water and wood double spiritual roots). 】
[Reward 6: The eldest daughter obtains the Taiyin Mysterious Body (not awakened). 】
Even though Li Changsheng had rich life experience, he was extremely happy after being hit by this series of rewards.
【Shouyuan】
【Cultivation】
【Weapon】
【luck】
All four are good things.
Moreover, his eldest daughter's talent is still the best among the best.
The two spiritual roots of water and wood are recognized as the spiritual roots of immortality in the world of immortality.
Aquatic wood.
Life goes on and on.
A monk with this kind of spiritual root.
Although the offensive power is not as violent as the Golden Fire Spiritual Root, its resilience is extremely strong, and she is good at refining elixirs and growing elixirs. She is the [Nanny] and [Logistics Manager] that all major sects compete for.
And there is another [Taiyin Mysterious Body]...
Although Li Changsheng has never heard of the specific effects, anything with the word "Physique" in it is considered a unique standard for geniuses in the world of immortality.
So I gave birth to a baby girl with the appearance of a true phoenix?
Li Changsheng happily stretched out his hand, stroked his beard, suppressed the ecstasy in his heart, walked to Wang Wenpo, and handed over a few gold coins.
"Thank you so much, Mrs. Wang Wen."
"Thank you, Immortal Master."
Wang Wenpo is also a good person, took the money.
Naturally, you know what to say and what not to say.
After Li Changsheng sent Wen Po away, he quickly walked into the house.
The room was filled with a faint smell of blood and milk.
Jiang Cuiping's face was pale, her hair was soaked with sweat and stuck to her forehead, making her look particularly weak.
But her eyes sparkled with maternal brilliance.
She looked lovingly at the pink and tender little package in her arms.
Seeing Li Changsheng come in, Jiang Cuiping struggled to get up, her eyes were red and she felt a little guilty:
"Husband, I'm sorry. It's a girl..."
In this world that favors boys over girls.
Especially in the family concept that pays attention to inheritance, the first child is a daughter, which often makes women feel that they cannot hold their heads high.
"What nonsense are you talking about?"
"What's wrong girl?"
"Girls are also a pet peeve."
"I don't have these patriarchal ideas here."
Li Changsheng pretended to be angry and glared at Jiang Cuiping.
Then he walked to Jiang Cuiping's bedside, held his wrist, and transferred a gentle spiritual power into his body.
Jiang Cuiping felt a warm current flowing through her body.
The severe pain caused by childbirth was relieved by most of it.
"Husband."
"That's so kind of you."
Jiang Cuiping breathed a sigh of relief and couldn't help but speak.
After saying that.
He turned his head shyly.
He didn't dare to look into Li Changsheng's eyes.
The newborn baby has his eyes closed and his eyelashes are long.
Although the skin is a little wrinkled, it is white and rosy, and the little mouth is pouting, which is really cute.
"Husband, give the child a name."
Jiang Cuiping was silent for a while before speaking.
Li Changsheng pondered for a moment and nodded:
"Then let's call him Li Yining."
"I don't ask her to rule the country, nor do I ask her to rule the world."
"I just want to give her a peaceful life."
Jiang Cuiping murmured and repeated: "Li Yining... Yining... I promise you a peaceful life... this has a good meaning."
That night.
After his wife and daughter went to bed, Li Changsheng arranged a [Spirit Gathering Array] and a [Sound Isolation Array] beside the bed so that they could sleep better.
Then a man came to the basement, sat cross-legged, and spoke excitedly:
"System, present rewards!"
[Instruction received. 】
【Shouyuan+30 years】
[Cultivation improves. 】
[Obtain the mysterious level spiritual weapon Xuan Shuang Sword. 】
[Get blessings from luck...]
As the system beep sounded, a warm current rose up in Li Changsheng's body. The bottleneck at the peak of the sixth level of Qi training was like a layer of tissue paper, which was instantly pierced, and his cultivation level climbed steadily.
Seven levels of Qi training.
Eight levels of Qi training.
Nine levels of Qi training.
His cultivation level skyrocketed and did not stop until the early stage of the ninth level of Qi training.
Li Changsheng opened his eyes, and there was a faint light flowing in his eyes.
This is the ninth level of Qi training!
In the outer sect of Qingyun Sect, in the later stages of Qi training, one can serve as a deacon and oversee hundreds of disciples.
in this resettlement area.
It is an absolute overlord level existence.
If that dead ghost Wang Mazi were alive, he would probably have to kneel down and call him grandpa when he saw Li Changsheng now.
Really awesome.
Next, how about taking a look at the spirit sword that is rewarded by the system?
Li Changsheng thought, and a spiritual sword appeared out of thin air in his hand.
The spirit sword is completely blue.
A three-foot sword.
Covered in frost.
Runes flow.
Cold light flickered.
This is the mysterious spiritual weapon.
It is said that only direct disciples have the chance to obtain Xuan level spiritual weapons.
Now he is an optimized disciple.
He actually possesses a mysterious level spiritual weapon.
It's so enviable.
No matter how you say it, having an additional means of saving your life is something to be happy about.
Then Li Changsheng opened the attribute panel, and the three-dimensional attributes were clearly visible.
【Family Prosperity System】
[Host: Li Changsheng]
[Taoist Companion: Jiang Cuiping (mortal without spiritual roots)]
[Family: Li family (obscure)]
[Remaining lifespan: 62]
[Cultivation: Nine levels of Qi training]
[Skills: True interpretation of spiritual talismans, basic sword skills, basic boxing skills. 】
[Weapon: Xuanshuang Sword]
[Children: eldest daughter: Li Yining]
Looking at the three-dimensional attributes, Li Changsheng didn’tThere is floating.
Although the birth of her eldest daughter has made her much stronger, her responsibilities have also increased.
Household expenses have also increased.
These are real pressures.
Ning Ning has dual spiritual roots of water and wood, and possesses a Taiyin mysterious body. If he is fed with mortal grains for a long time, his innate spiritual energy will be polluted. He must drink rice soup made from spiritual rice, or even mild spirit animal milk.
Isn’t this the pressure of being a father?
And in order to cover up the spiritual root fluctuations and physical abnormalities in the child.
I still have to buy a piece of [Xi Leng Peng].
This is another huge sum of money.
Alexander!
Then I thought about it.
Although raising a daughter is very expensive.
But his strength is bound to his family.
Raise your daughter.
Develop a family.
Not a loss.
Li Changsheng put away the Xuanshuang Sword and murmured:
"It seems I can only go to the ghost market once."
Early the next morning, Li Changsheng arranged for his wife and daughter, and arranged warning measures and traps.
Only then did Weiwei go out with peace of mind.
Although this is a resettlement area at the foot of Qingyun Mountain, it is not absolutely safe.
In the world of immortality, if you want to live a long time, you must be steady.
Li Changsheng used [Bone Shrinking Technique], and his bones crackled.
In the blink of an eye, he transformed from a rickety old man to a straight-backed, black-faced man.
Cultivation is also suppressed at the sixth level of Qi training.
It just happens to be the kind of casual cultivator standard that says "Don't mess with me, but don't mess with me either".
Then...
Put it on and cover your face with spiritual power.
Then he quickly walked towards the ghost market thirty miles away.
The volume of the nearby market was too low to accommodate large quantities of talismans, so we had no choice but to take risks in the ghost market.
The ghost market is located in an abandoned mine.
It is no longer clear who established it.
But there must be traces of the Immortal Cultivation Sect behind it, otherwise it would not be possible for it to exist for so long without being wiped out.
As soon as Li Changsheng reached the entrance of the ghost market, two monks at the ninth level of Qi training stretched out their hands to block his way.
"Stop."
"Pay the admission fee first."
"Two low-grade spiritual stones for each person."
Do I have to pay to enter the black market?
So dark!
Li Changsheng complained in his heart.
He was no nonsense, though.
Directly handed over two spiritual stones.
Although it costs money to enter the black market, it is not a bad thing to save trouble.
Li Changsheng received a black cloak, put it on his body, and quickly blended into the black market crowd.
